Name: Clint Sells Bars
Author: ManaketeSmoocher
Description:
Ever been in late-game, desperately needing iron and copper for your kegs, but not having the time or patience to micro-manage your furnaces to make it? Well you're in luck, because now Clint is offering to smelt it for you! Just pay the price of materials and a small service fee and you'll get to walk away with as many bars you can afford, and none of the hassle!

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿
[*]Download Clint Sells Bars and unzip it to your mods folder!
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Clint Sells Bars
Manifest.Description: A simple mod that allows Clint to sell Copper, Iron, and Gold bars.
